boundaries.name: \Gamma_H
boundaries.description: central segment of the bottom edge (length 0.4) swept by flue gas, convective heating with h_H and u_H

boundaries.name: \Gamma_a
boundaries.description: rest of the bottom edge, adiabatic

boundaries.name: \Gamma_c
boundaries.description: three remaining edges exchanging heat with ambient air through effective convective coefficient h at u_amb; its shape is optimised

objective.name: J
objective.description: keeps the heated surface cold at fixed material cost, maximizing the heat absorbed from the hot fluid; the heated-surface temperature integral is weighted by q_b = h_H (u_H - u_amb)

state_equation.description: Linear heat conduction in the domain with Robin conditions on the heated bottom segment and the cooled edges; the temperature is fixed implicitly by the ambient air through the Robin condition (no Dirichlet condition)
state_equation.weak_form_lhs: \int_{D} k \chi (\nabla u \cdot \nabla \delta u) \,dx + \int_{\Gamma_H} h_H u \delta u \,ds_x + \int_{\Gamma_c} h u \delta u \,ds_x
state_equation.weak_form_rhs: \int_{\Gamma_H} h_H u_{H} \delta u \,ds_x + \int_{\Gamma_c} h u_{amb} \delta u \,ds_x

adjoint_equation.description: Solution of the adjoint problem; the adjoint load comes from the partial derivative of the heated-surface temperature integral in the objective
adjoint_equation.weak_form_lhs: \int_{D} k \chi (\nabla \delta u \cdot \nabla \tilde u) \,dx + \int_{\Gamma_H} h_H \delta u \tilde u \,ds_x + \int_{\Gamma_c} h \delta u \tilde u \,ds_x
